title: Screen all 2026 500盤 restaurants for real solo meals <=NT$500
question: Across all 314 restaurants in the official 2026 500盤 corpus, which currently support a realistic one-person meal with an unavoidable bill <=NT$500, and which survivors remain worth tracking after price, portion, operations, award-dish, and adversarial checks?
acceptance_criteria: Lock the official 314-restaurant 2026 corpus and preserve source caveats.
Give every restaurant at least a triage disposition without wasting equal depth on obviously incompatible fine-dining floors.
Count all unavoidable charges and reject cheap-item, coupon, and shared-bill loopholes.
For every QUALIFIED/BORDERLINE candidate, capture current attributable menu/price evidence.
For stable QUALIFIED, verify solo ordering, portion sufficiency, hidden charges, hours/open status, queue/reservation friction, and deliberate negative evidence.
Prioritize Taipei-core usability while retaining national travel candidates.
Preserve contradictory prices, closures, and freshness uncertainty.
